q: I attack with a Digimon that has this card in its digivolution cards when my opponent has just 1 Digimon with
, and my opponent's Digimon blocks. If this means my opponent no longer has any unsuspended Digimon, does this card's inherited effect give my Digimon +1000 DP upon a battle?

Effect: ＜Jamming＞ (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.)
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] While your opponent has no unsuspended Digimon, this Digimon gets +1000 DP.
